title: Informed Consent
description: The user may not be fully aware of what data is being collected by the wearable device, leading to a lack of informed consent regarding the data collection process.

title: Data Integrity
description: The wearable device may be susceptible to data manipulation, leading to inaccurate sensor telemetry being recorded and transmitted.

title: Data Disclosure
description: The wearable device may inadvertently disclose sensitive user data (e.g., GPS location) to unauthorized parties during data transmission or storage.

title: Data Disclosure from Wearable Device
description: The wearable device may unintentionally disclose personal data such as exercise sessions, GPS traces, and device ID when syncing with the companion app, potentially exposing this data to unauthorized parties.

title: Data Disclosure at Companion App
description: The companion app may store or process the received data in a way that could lead to unauthorized access or sharing of personal data, such as exercise sessions and GPS traces, with third parties.

title: Unawareness of Data Sharing
description: The user may not be fully aware that their personal data (calorie intake, meals, weight) is being shared with the Companion Mobile App, leading to potential unintentional sharing of sensitive information.

title: Lack of User Consent
description: The app may collect and store health logs without obtaining explicit consent from the user, leading to a lack of transparency and potential violation of privacy rights.

title: Data Disclosure to Unauthorized Parties
description: Health logs stored in the health log store may be accessed by unauthorized parties, either through inadequate security measures or data breaches, leading to the disclosure of sensitive personal information.

title: Data Disclosure of GPS Location
description: The Companion Mobile App collects and writes GPS location traces with timestamps to the Location History Store, which may lead to the unintended disclosure of personal location data to unauthorized parties or systems.

title: Data Disclosure of Stored Location Data
description: The Location History Store may expose stored GPS location data to unauthorized access or sharing, leading to potential privacy violations for users.

title: Data Disclosure from Health Log Store
description: The Health Log Store (DS1) may disclose personal health data (calorie, weight, exercise logs) to the Health Analytics Service (P3) without ensuring that only the necessary data is shared, leading to potential over-sharing of sensitive information.

title: Data Disclosure by Health Analytics Service
description: The Health Analytics Service (P3) may process and store personal health data in a way that could lead to unintended data disclosures, either through inadequate access controls or by retaining data longer than necessary.

title: Data Disclosure of Location History
description: The location history data being shared from the Location History Store (DS2) to the Health Analytics Service (P3) may lead to the disclosure of personal data, including sensitive information about an individual's daily routines and movement patterns. This could happen either explicitly through the analytics service's queries or implicitly through derived insights from the data.

title: Inadequate Data Anonymization
description: The Health Analytics Service (P3) may inadequately anonymize the location data received from the Location History Store (DS2), leading to potential identification of individuals based on their movement patterns. This could result in privacy violations if the data is not properly handled or anonymized before analysis.

title: Identifying Threats from Health Data
description: The Health Analytics Service may inadvertently reveal the identity of individuals through the inferred insights shared with the Companion Mobile App, especially if the data is not adequately anonymized or aggregated.

title: Profiling a Group of Individuals
description: The Companion Mobile App may use the health insights to profile groups of individuals, leading to potential discrimination or stigmatization based on inferred health conditions.

title: Insufficient Cybersecurity Risk Management
description: The data flow between the Health Analytics Service and the Companion Mobile App may be vulnerable to cybersecurity risks, leading to potential non-compliance with privacy regulations if proper security measures are not implemented.

title: Linkability of User Data
description: The app may link user data to identifiable individuals, potentially allowing for tracking and profiling of users based on their health indicators.

title: Data Disclosure to Unauthorized Parties
description: The user may inadvertently disclose sensitive health information to unauthorized parties through the app's dashboard, especially if the device is shared or accessed by others.

title: Non-compliance with Health Data Regulations
description: The app may not comply with health data regulations (e.g., HIPAA, GDPR) regarding the handling and sharing of sensitive health information, leading to legal risks.

title: Data Disclosure to Cloud Provider
description: The health analytics service shares sensitive health and location data with the cloud hosting provider, which may lead to unintended data disclosure if the provider does not have adequate security measures in place.

title: Data Disclosure by Cloud Provider
description: The cloud hosting provider may inadvertently disclose the hosted health analytics data to unauthorized parties, either through inadequate access controls or data breaches.
